name: Newsroom AI Assistant – Editorial Workflow & News SEO Engine
author: koskar22

sections.description:
Newsroom AI Assistant is not just another SEO or AI plugin. It is a dedicated Newsroom Operating System built specifically for publishers, Editors-in-Chief, and high-paced editorial teams.

Generic SEO plugins (like Yoast or RankMath) are built for blogs and affiliate sites. Newsroom AI Assistant is built for the daily news cycle, helping your team answer the 3 most important questions: What is trending? Who is writing it? How do we optimize it for Google Discover?

🧠 The Newsroom Copilot (Workflow)

Stop relying on a messy mix of Slack, Trello, and external trend tools. Bring your entire editorial workflow inside the WordPress dashboard:
* Editorial Task Manager: Create upcoming news events, assign topics directly to journalists, and set “Lead Days” countdown alerts.
* Chief Editor Notes: Pass crucial instructions directly to the writer’s editor screen (e.g., “Get a quote from the Mayor”).
* 🔥 NEW: Dashboard Trends Widget: See the top 5 trending topics in your country the second you log into WordPress!

🚀 News SEO & Discover Optimization tools

Equip your journalists with tools that save time and boost your Google News & Discover traffic:
* Smart Internal Linking: Scan your database with one click based on Post Tags and keywords. Insert highly contextual “Read Also” links with SEO-friendly HTML title attributes.
* Live European Google Trends: View real-time, chronological Google Trends without leaving the post editor. Switch instantly between Greece, Cyprus, UK, USA, Germany, France, Italy, Spain, and Turkey via AJAX.
* Trending Headlines Generator: Engineered AI Prompts ready to be copied into ChatGPT or Gemini. Generate click-worthy Discover titles, emotional headlines, output JSON-LD FAQ Schema, and extract LSI keywords.

👑 The Vision: The Ultimate Newsroom OS

We are continuously building features to transform WordPress into a Publisher’s powerhouse.

Support & Contact: Need help or want to request a feature for your media group? Contact the developer at koskar22@gmail.com.
sections.installation:
1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin panel and navigate to Plugins > Add New.
  3. Click Upload Plugin and choose the zip file.
  4. Click Install Now and then Activate.
  5. Go to the new AI Assistant menu to set your target country and start assigning Editorial Tasks.
